title: Incident severity, the incident commander and one channel for communication

videos.script: It is the last afternoon of September, and a shop owner calls support. She has been charged twice for her subscription. {{call}} What happens in the next fifteen minutes decides how long a hundred other shops stay charged twice. {{fifteen}} Nobody knows the cause yet. Nobody needs to. {{cause}} Somebody declares an incident, and it costs one command. {{declare}} Somebody picks a severity, from what the shops are suffering, not from what broke. {{severity}} One person takes command, and gives the others their jobs. One fixes. One tells everybody else. One writes it all down. {{roles}} And everything is said in one place. {{channel}} This lesson sets out those pieces, and then follows the Billing team through its first fifteen minutes, minute by minute. {{minutes}}
